verdict: No blocking acceptance-driver or CI integration issue found in the inspected final worktree.
review_scope: Read-only code/CI review; independently executed lightweight oracle self-test and syntax/static manifest checks. No production/main-oracle edits, no Cargo or builds, and no full suite/browser/wheel rerun.
checks: Mainoracle --binary executes self_test first. Fresh self-test passes all 25 mutations, including missing/nonbase/orphan/image bytes, slot/UV/scalars, equal-byte logical image identity, reflected tangent/corner and companion presence.

Extended matcher compares every authored companion and material meaning as one oriented triangle, allows only common cyclic corner rotation, exact W and component-specific storage tolerances. No projection removes newly admitted channels.

Shared archive inspector checks finite decoded payload, CRC/index/inventory, exact local and global closure, exact bytes/MIME/image identities, source physical resource counts, profile/schema/report fields, per-leaf triangle limit and stored/ancestor bounds.

Refusal matrix expects InvalidInput for malformed encoding and Unsupported for stated finite policy. Both CLI exit code/kind and installed typed exception/kind are checked; output parents must remain absent.

Installed empty-PATH API directly exercises 94 positive scenarios and 140 refusals with independently inspected output and source preservation; the --core-pbr adapter additionally checks CLI/extension report and archive-member byte parity.

Pinned Three viewer uses standard GLTFLoader and MeshStandardMaterial without shader/material overrides. It compares 36 analytical sample pixels across six panels, requires visible reference panels and real draw calls, detects all ten wrong UV/slot/frame/texture/scalar/color controls above the same threshold, and rejects request/page failures.

Three extracted-leaf viewing deliberately shares the glTF coordinate frame. Claims remain scoped to pinned renderer/lighting/samples; separate Cesium traversal and independent reflection/nested/nonorthogonal arithmetic are retained.

Revised CI runs f1b3_khronos.py on the freshly built native binary with conda library path. Harness first applies complete independent inspection, then extracts every emitted leaf, validates all 26 sources and complete 104-leaf inventory through the official helper, resolves external images and rejects errors/truncation/warnings. This closes the initial source-only CI coverage gap.

Validator helper confines real resolved source/resource paths to its supplied root, performs one component decoding pass, disallows schemes/fragments/queries/separator escapes, and records URI/path/byte/hash callbacks. CI installs exact validator2.0.0-dev.3.10, Three0.180.0, Cesium1.146.0 and Playwright1.63.0; Chromium installation and paths are supplied.

Resource probe uses distinct literal 100000-triangle single/many-leaf and shared-six-attribute/4096-primitive workloads; overlimit refuses before sampled scratch. Its wait4 RSS and sampled descriptors/children/scratch limitations are stated rather than presented as universal hard bounds.

archived_receipt_inspection.note: Examined existing final receipt; not a new independent validator execution.

proof_limits: Current glTF accessor helper is a semantic fidelity oracle and is not a complete general JSON/schema validator. Revised official source-and-generated-leaf CI checks provide that complementary validation.
No live hosted CI result is asserted. Workflow commands, dependency placement, source/leaf harness and assertion paths were inspected; local final receipts are separate executed evidence.

Source-preservation assertions are strongest for positive installed API/adapter cases. Refusal source preservation is also independently exercised by the fresh 27-case review; current mainoracle refusal driver principally checks classification and absent output work.
